title: Interviewing Havana syndrome victims
place_text: Cuba, Russia, China, Austria, Germany, Switzerland, United States

tellings.quote:
>> Yeah. We've been interviewing victims of
Havana syndrome. Yeah.

plain: Chris Gilbert, speaking on a podcast episode with a former head of the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, says he and his colleagues have been interviewing victims of Havana syndrome. That is the name for unexplained illnesses reported by US diplomats and intelligence staff in places such as Cuba, Russia, China, Austria, Germany, Switzerland and the United States. The interviews matter because they gather first-hand accounts of what the victims went through.
